scope_fidelity.evidence: DAY07 remains audit/disposition only; DAY08 freeze and later implementation are explicitly excluded.

technical_depth.evidence: Family-specific disposition, repo scanning, regression boundaries, technical-debt closure evidence and negative cases are concrete.

execution_clarity.evidence: 13 independently verifiable STEPs each use the required Goal/Input/Why/Action/Command/Expected/Verify/Stop/Pass format.

beginner_usability.evidence: Commands, exact paths, expected output, examples and failure diagnosis are included.

testability.evidence: 30 automated tests plus repo-evidence and human-review gates.

traceability.evidence: PRD Product Principles, NFR-001 and NFR-011 have explicit artifact/test linkage.

safety_rigor.evidence: No public-to-site evidence promotion, no MFCV assumption, no classifier-first revival, fail-closed status rules.

reproducibility.evidence: Regression scope, versioning, deterministic audit outputs and SHA-256 provenance are specified.

repo_integration.evidence: Branch, collision review, rsync dry-run, actual copy, previous-day regression, diff and rollback are documented.

troubleshooting.evidence: Negative checks and stop conditions are present per step; repo-specific unexpected layouts still require human judgment.

teaching_quality.evidence: Vocabulary map, analogies, limitations, worked examples, flashcards, exercises, quiz and teach-back are included.

feynman_depth.evidence: Core concepts move from simple explanation to analogy, technical definition, MotionLab application and counterexample.

worked_examples.evidence: RMS reuse, confidence ambiguity and unsafe MFCV enablement are developed end-to-end.

exercises.evidence: 3 beginner, 2 intermediate and 1 integration exercise plus 15-question quiz.

handoff_clarity.evidence: DAY08 receives exact artifact list and GO/READY/BLOCKED rules.
